method.adaptation: one forward pass to update BN statistics, with a recording-level 95% collapse guard
method.split: fixed stratified 25% holdout by patient; Yaseen uses fold 0 clip IDs
method.scoring: window-weighted mean probability per patient; refer if 1 - p(Normal) >= 0.5
method.recovery: (adapted - plain) / (clean - plain); null when the clean-to-shift gap is nonpositive
method.intervals: 95% patient bootstrap, 1000 resamples, seed 0; metrics averaged across draws before intervals
method.stress_batches: class labels control sample composition; the adaptation model only receives windows
